prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in League City, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1007; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision you reported. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give you my first name and last initial, if that's all right.

Q: That's fine. Where did the collision happen?

A: It was on a multi-lane road in League City, Texas, near a shopping center entrance.

Q: Can you walk me through what you were doing right before impact?

A: I was driving in the right lane and wanted to move over to the left lane to get ready for my exit. I checked my mirror and glanced over my shoulder, and I didn't see anything close. When I started to move over, the other car came up on my left side and we scraped along each other.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you began your lane change?

A: Not that I remember. It seemed to come out of my blind spot quickly.

Q: Were you using your turn signal?

A: Yes, I had it on for a few seconds before I moved over.

Q: Did you or the other driver stop after the contact?

A: We both pulled onto the shoulder. The other driver got out and we exchanged information.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic later that day. I have been having pain in my neck and lower back, and it's stiff when I wake up in the morning.

Q: Have you had any prior neck or back problems?

A: I had some mild back soreness a few years ago, but it went away with rest and I didn't need treatment.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want my car and my health taken care of.

Q: Understood. This concludes the recorded statement. Thank you.
